newMuslims.title: The year after the shahada is where faith is kept — or quietly lost.
newMuslims.p1: Across Latin America, people find Islam every day — and most of them find it alone. No classes in their language. No one to teach them to pray. No one to sit with at Eid. Da’wah celebrates the moment of conversion; almost nothing is built for the year that follows.
newMuslims.p2: Emara Academy exists for that year, and every year after it: weekly classes in Spanish and Portuguese, a mentor within your first two weeks, dignified help when life gets hard, and a community that already knows your name.
